definitions.explanation: A room in a house designated for receiving and entertaining guests.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{客|きゃく}さん→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{客間|きゃくま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|とお}した→通す：02300_toosu⟧。
examples.english: I showed the guest to the parlor.

examples.japanese: {客間|きゃくま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}った→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: I decorated the guest room with flowers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{伝統的|でんとうてき}な→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{客間|きゃくま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Traditional Japanese houses have a guest room.

examples.japanese: {客間|きゃくま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦お{客|きゃく}さん→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}った→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: I cleaned the guest room and waited for the visitor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{親戚|しんせき}→親戚：03260_shinseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、{客間|きゃくま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}した→用意する：01746_youi⟧。
examples.english: Since relatives are coming after a long time, I prepared futons in the guest room.

notes:
{客間|きゃくま} is a room specifically designated for receiving guests.

In traditional Japanese homes:
- Often a tatami room ({和室|わしつ})
- May have a {床|とこ}の{間|ま} (alcove) for decoration
- Used for formal occasions and visitors

Related terms:
- {居間|いま} (living room - for family use)
- {応接間|おうせつま} (reception room - more formal)
- {座敷|ざしき} (Japanese-style room, often for guests)
- リビング (living room - modern style)

Usage:
- {客間|きゃくま}に{通|とお}す (to show someone to the guest room)
- {客間|きゃくま}で{もてなす} (to entertain in the guest room)
